name: portfolio-design-toolkit
description: Portfolio and frontend design workflows that preserve project identity, coordinate specialist design skills, and guide redesign, UI motion, reference analysis, audit, polish, and pre-release verification.

interface.longDescription: A project-first portfolio design toolkit that preserves PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md and AGENTS.md as source-of-truth, then routes work to focused skills for redesign, authored visual direction, React Bits integration, reference-site analysis and final UI/UX polish.
defaultPrompt: Improve this portfolio while preserving its established visual identity.
Audit this portfolio and propose the highest-impact bounded fixes.
Polish this portfolio for release across responsive, motion, accessibility, and performance.
